text: Full mockup-to-implementation specification is docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, linked from the M1 entry and mockup index. It defines four configurations, one shared controller, complete-inventory versus readable-detail mapping, required producer capabilities, ten reuse-first landings and eleven acceptance courts. M1 scope/dependencies remain unchanged; later source exploration, scale and film/media complete the visual destination. Provider adoption must resolve the draft/admitted-source relationship and lawful M1-to-Voyage adapter before closure. Planning only; no runtime or scientific qualification.
